svg.title: Risk score learning interaction
svg.desc: Teaching formula: score = L × I. L and I are ordinal integers from 1–5, not loss ratios. Thresholds: 1–4 low, 5–9 medium, 10–25 high. These thresholds are set by this teaching example, not official ISO values. The high-risk example calls for escalated review and priority treatment.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Illustrative thresholds; organizations define their own risk criteria.
Teaching formula: score = L × I. L and I are ordinal integers from 1–5

thresholds are set by this teaching example, not official ISO values.
The high-risk example calls for escalated review and priority
